text: maya: quick design review for compact roles table — main points: global SSO control vs per-role override, inline lock affordance, audit drill-in UX (drawer vs full page), and a11y/copy nits. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/qwerty/compact-roles-iter4 frame: compact-v3. sam: prefer global toggle in header + per-role override in kebab. show a small lock only for overridden roles. shorter copy: 'Require SSO'. jeff: a11y: if lock is decorative use aria-hidden and expose an sr-only span like 'SSO required for Billing'. avoid extra tabbable elements in each row. nina: audit detail: open a right-hand drawer filtered to the role. deep-link via query string '?drawer=audit&role=billing' so people can bookmark. drawer should announce its heading with aria-live when opened. maya: bulk action copy: heading 'Require SSO for selected roles' body 'Users without SSO will lose access until they enable SSO.' CTA 'Apply requirement'. show warning if >500 users affected. sam: engineering asks: lazy-render lock svg for virtual lists, provide API flag per_role.sso_required, and audit endpoint with role filter. jeff: keyboard nav: roving tabindex for rows, Enter to open kebab, esc to close drawer and return focus. add toast live-region 'polite' for changes. ops-bot: preview build: https://preview.redwood.ai/compact-roles/v3 — expires in 72h. maya: thanks — i'll update figma and add a short NVDA screencap + keynav doc. marking design-approved pending the a11y fixes and dev tickets. :white_check_mark:
